expectations.text: States the regime: limited assurance is required on CSRD sustainability reporting (the empowerment for reasonable-assurance standards was REMOVED by the Omnibus, so limited assurance remains the regime)
expectations.evidence: "The Omnibus removed the empowerment for reasonable-assurance standards, so limited assurance remains the regime"

expectations.text: Reports the September milestone: CEAOB delivered its technical advice on an EU limited-assurance standard on September 25, 2026
expectations.evidence: "CEAOB delivered its technical advice to the Commission on 25 September 2026"

expectations.text: Describes the mandate accurately without inventing content: the advice addresses EU-specific add-ons and potential carve-outs to ISSA 5000
expectations.evidence: "The advice proposes an EU limited-assurance standard built on ISSA 5000, with EU add-ons and carve-outs"

expectations.text: States the timeline: the Commission's limited-assurance delegated act is due by July 1, 2027
expectations.evidence: "The Commission's limited-assurance delegated act is due by 1 July 2027"

expectations.text: Explains current practice until then: assurance under national standards/member-state arrangements, with statutory auditors or (where allowed) independent assurance providers
expectations.evidence: "practitioners use national standards or international ones such as ISAE 3000 (Revised) and ISSA 5000, depending on the Member State's rules"; statutory auditor or IASP where Member State permits
